findings.summary: Commit 186d913 changes only app/LoopDiscovery.tsx and app/loop-discovery.css, as the bounded CODEX-02-A phone-layout correction allows. The new rule `.loop-discovery #discovery-family > header` beats the bare legacy `header` flex rule in globals.css:4 and applies only inside the discovery page, so the old demos are unaffected. The fixture controls move into a native details/summary panel, keeping all four buttons and the synthetic-boundary text. The existing real-DOM React test (all fixture/opt-in/expiry/no-network/no-cookie assertions), the 44-route probe, the seeded production scan, npm test (25/25) and the build all passed in the controller's run. The 320px browser check is controller evidence, not Claude-run. Only optional nits remain; no policy, data, route or status changes.

findings.title: No assertion that fixture controls are inside a collapsed details panel
findings.problem: The DOM test still proves the fixture buttons sit outside #discovery-family and work, but nothing checks that they are now inside a `details.discovery-fixtures` that starts closed with a visible summary. The collapse is the point of this correction. Today only the controller's browser run shows it. This is a meaningful structural check, not a check that just repeats the CSS.
findings.fix_check: Optionally assert `find('fixture-open').closest('details.discovery-fixtures')` exists, `.open === false` on first render, and the summary text matches /Developer fixture states/.

findings.title: Summary min-height without vertical alignment
findings.problem: The summary keeps its default list-item display with min-height 44px, so the label sits at the top of the 44px tap area rather than in the middle. Purely cosmetic: the tap target is still met, and the controller's browser check found it readable.
findings.fix_check: Optionally add padding-block or flex alignment like loop-player.css:17; check visually at 320px.
